title: The Ledger of Windrow House
author: Freya Dunmore
blurb: Mara Amberdale, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
